story.head: The Islanders can’t afford to take penalties
paras: The Islanders won the teams’ first meeting this season, 6-0 on Long Island on Oct 3. The Islanders (7-6-2) lost 5-3 to Carolina on Thursday, while the Devils have won three straight. This is a Metropolitan Division matchup, with the Devils second (tied for seventh in the NHL) and the Isles fifth (tied for 21st).

The Devils have played better than their record (.688) says: their chances are worth about .745, and their goaltending has held them back. The Islanders’ record (.533) is about what their chances are worth.

The Devils keep things calm after the whistle (2nd lowest), rarely throw hits (3rd lowest) and get pinned in their own end on long shifts (30th). The Islanders roll their lines more evenly than almost anyone (2nd) and have had some of the best goaltending in the league (2nd). They also get their defensemen shooting (1st), so their defensemen shoot a lot, and the Devils’ not so much. The Devils’ power play (6th) could do real damage against the Islanders’ penalty kill (30th), though their penalty killers create chances of their own going the other way.

Jack Hughes (8 G / 13 A / 21 P in 16 GP) leads the Devils in scoring, with nine points in his last five games and six goals in nine games against the Islanders since 2023-24. Jesper Bratt (3 G / 12 A / 15 P in 16 GP) is next in line. For the Islanders, Matthew Schaefer (4 G / 11 A / 15 P in 15 GP) leads the way in scoring. Bo Horvat (7 G / 7 A / 14 P in 15 GP) has a team-high seven goals, with eight goals in ten games against New Jersey since 2023-24.

Ilya Sorokin (6-4-0 / .911 SV% in 10 GS) has been a rock in net for the Islanders and will likely start. New Jersey has two options in net: Connor Hellebuyck (4-0-0 / .891 SV% in 4 GS) and Jake Allen (5-3-0 / .886 SV% in 8 GS). They have split the last ten starts, and Hellebuyck got the last one on Thursday. It’s anyone’s guess who gets the net.

items.text: Nico Hischier is two points from 500.
Anthony Duclair has five goals in six games against New Jersey since 2023-24.

The Islanders are newly without Ryan Pulock, have been without Matias Maccelli since Oct 17, and have had to make do without Mathew Barzal all season. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, only the Mammoth and the Ducks are missing more right now.
Luke Hughes has six goals on chances worth about 2.1 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
